_comment: Aspirational gate for the agentic attack dataset. These thresholds describe what a PRODUCTION prompt-injection guard should clear, not what the shipped keyword/regex guards achieve — see docs/AGENTIC_RESULTS.md. The `agentic` CI job runs this gate non-required (continue-on-error) so the gap is visible without blocking merges. The gate loader ignores this `_comment` key. Attack-family slices use `attack:<family>` keys; `*/fa` targets every Farsi language slice so a guard cannot pass by covering English only.
